anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
Which behavior should the workspace-switch policy apply to the report view's active filters?
A) clear - drop all active filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve - keep all active filters across switches
C) restore - bring back each workspace's last-used filters
Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in ui/report-view.ts already keeps active filters, so the policy resolves through settings/resolver.ts:12 with no behavior change for existing users and no new per-workspace filter state (C would need that state outside the resolver).

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
What should happen to report filters when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves current behavior and avoids adding per-workspace filter state.
